subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw's user-facing agent and tool-output paths keep compact `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` display, switch to full absolute paths by default, or offer an explicit display preference?
rationale: Current code intentionally shortens home paths, the related merged fix preserved that policy, and changing defaults or adding an env/config surface is a UX/product decision rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default display and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Absolute Paths By Default
options.body: Change shared display helpers and agent prompt guidance so user-visible home paths render as full absolute paths.

options.title: Add Explicit Display Preference
options.body: Add a documented preference or env var for users who want full absolute paths while keeping existing compact defaults.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default display and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the central home-path shortening behavior and is the strongest history signal for the display-policy choice.
